{{nihongo|'''Sakuta Shrine'''|佐久太神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Sakuta Shrine''' (さくたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tomika, Gifu|arz|توميكا|ceb|Tomika-chō|es|Tomika (Gifu)|fa|تومیکا، گیفو|fr|Tomika|it|Tomika|ja|富加町|ko|도미카정|ms|Tomika, Gifu|my|တိုမိခမြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Tomika|ru|Томика|tl|Tomika, Gifu|tr|Tomika|uk|Томіка|ur|ٹومیکا، گیفو|uz|Tomika (Gifu)|zh|富加町|qid=Q1203855}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Gifu|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Gifu-ken)|es|Distrito de Kamo (Gifu)|fr|District de Kamo (Gifu)|id|Distrik Kamo, Gifu|it|Distretto di Kamo (Gifu)|ja|加茂郡|ko|가모군 (기후현)|pl|Powiat Kamo|pt|Distrito de Kamo|th|อำเภอคาโมะ|uk|Повіт Камо (Ґіфу)|vi|Kamo (quận)|zh|加茂郡|qid=Q1348656}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is the {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}} Kamo District Sakuta Shrine listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha register}}. Its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former rank}} was village shrine.

=== Overview ===
The date of founding is unknown. It is said to have been called "Kumano Gongen" in the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}.
